head: qwy I (< Arab. qwy cf. Wehr 1072: stark, kräftig, mächtig sein oder werden;)

examples.turoyo: qay abri? hawi gušmux qawi w hawi foṯux saməq
examples.translation: wieso denn, mein Sohn? Ist denn dein Körper nicht schon kräftig und dein Gesicht frisch rot geworden?
examples.raw: qay abri? hawi gušmux qawi w hawi foṯux saməq ʻwieso denn, mein Sohn? Ist denn dein Körper nicht schon kräftig und dein Gesicht frisch rot geworden?ʼ; 617; 76/140;

examples.turoyo: hano ġắlabe qawi b-lebe ḏ̣əd d-aloho hul dáraǧe, d-ko-mankər u=wuǧūd d-aloho
examples.translation: He was strongly disaffected against God to such an extent that he denied the very existence of God
examples.raw: hano ġắlabe qawi b-lebe ḏ̣əd d-aloho hul dáraǧe, d-ko-mankər u=wuǧūd d-aloho ‘He was strongly disaffected against God to such an extent that he denied the very existence of God’; 43/6 [MT]

examples.translation: vielleicht wird er dann ein wenig kräftig
examples.raw: balki qowe əšmo ʻvielleicht wird er dann ein wenig kräftigʼ; 617; 76/133;

examples.turoyo: kət-lan arwono g-nəḥrina-le saymina-le qaliyo w-gəd-muklina-le l-u=zʕur-ano balki qowe əšmo w-gušme miʕadəl
examples.translation: We have a calf. We are going to slaughter it and prepare a piece of meat from it and we are going to feed it to the boy. Perhaps he will get a bit stronger, and his body will be in a good condition
examples.raw: kət-lan arwono g-nəḥrina-le saymina-le qaliyo w-gəd-muklina-le l-u=zʕur-ano balki qowe əšmo w-gušme miʕadəl ‘We have a calf. We are going to slaughter it and prepare a piece of meat from it and we are going to feed it to the boy. Perhaps he will get a bit stronger, and his body will be in a good condition’ 76/133;

senses.gloss: stark machen, (foṯe ʕal) zudringlich werden, jm. zusetzen;

stems.sensesRaw: stark machen, (foṯe ʕal) zudringlich werden, jm. zusetzen;

examples.turoyo: ʕal d-maqwele foṯe ġắlabe, ašər, mḥéli-le lakmo ʕal foṯe
examples.translation: Since he was very importunate, sure I gave him a slap in the face
examples.raw: ʕal d-maqwele foṯe ġắlabe, ašər, mḥéli-le lakmo ʕal foṯe ʻSince he was very importunate, sure I gave him a slap in the faceʼ; 617; 43/53;
ono… maqweli lebi ‘ich fasste mir ein Herz’; 116/32;

examples.turoyo: yawmo həngi maqwele ʕal u=babo omər adyawma lo=k-owe illa g-əzzino qm-aʕ=ʕeze ono w-hat g-məṯnoḥət
examples.translation: One day he pestered his father, saying: “Today I am certainly going with the goats, and you are going to take a rest” 75/52;
examples.raw: yawmo həngi maqwele ʕal u=babo omər adyawma lo=k-owe illa g-əzzino qm-aʕ=ʕeze ono w-hat g-məṯnoḥət ‘One day he pestered his father, saying: “Today I am certainly going with the goats, and you are going to take a rest” 75/52;

examples.turoyo: hat maqwelux aʕli b-u=šeyolo w-hul d-məllilux u=mede d-kət-wa b-lebi
examples.translation: You have pestered me with questions to the point that I told what was on my mind
examples.raw: hat maqwelux aʕli b-u=šeyolo w-hul d-məllilux u=mede d-kət-wa b-lebi ‘You have pestered me with questions to the point that I told what was on my mind’ 82/37;

examples.translation: so habe ich mir Mut zugesprochen, liebe Brüder
examples.raw: hawxa ko-maqweno b-lebe d-ruḥi, aḥunone ‘so habe ich mir Mut zugesprochen, liebe Brüder’; LB 162;
